📢📢📢My book, Deep Unlearning, is now available for preorders at simonandschuster.com/books/D…

I don't know how people write so many books because this one took a lot out of me. It turns out, I had a lot to say 😂, with editors cutting out 50k of my words 🫣
PS. Thank you to all the people who participated in my cover questionnaire, where I randomly stopped you at a bookstore and asked you which cover you like when we were deciding on covers.
And thank you most of all to the people who have already read the book, and gave feedback and advice, especially Alex Hanna, Emily M. Bender and Chanda Prescod-Weinstein.
